title: ConductorSigning
description: Operational RPC contract (Category C) for elohim-storage to request the conductor to sign canonical bytes under a specific agent's key. The conductor holds the agent's lair-managed private key; storage holds neither key material nor signing authority. Used to compose EPR Envelopes from /api/v1/signal/emit (EPR Phase 2B Batch C) when the caller cannot sign in-browser. The signed bytes returned become part of an Envelope (Category A) after EprService::ingest. The signer-match gate in the imagodei coordinator function rejects calls where the caller's agent pubkey does not match the Agent EPR identified by agentCid.

agentCid.description: CIDv1 of the Agent EPR whose key should sign. Caller's agent pubkey must match this EPR's holochain_agent_key (signer-match gate).

canonicalBytes.description: Base64-encoded canonical bytes to sign. For EPR composition this is the Envelope's canonical CBOR serialization (envelope-ex-proof + payload).

signature.description: Base64-encoded raw Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over canonicalBytes.

signerPubkey.description: Base64-encoded raw Ed25519 public key (32 bytes) of the signing agent. Returned for defense-in-depth: callers can verify the signature against this pubkey before ingesting the resulting EPR.
